split_policy: Only listed training views are loaded; evaluation images are neither embedded nor read.
review_semantics: Leaf review confirms visible B-to-T path placement, not Q physical matching. Separate midrib correspondence confirmation is optional and still requires downstream geometric checks. Outline reviews certify view-local visible boundary strokes, never cross-view W correspondences or unseen anatomical boundaries.

point_semantics.T: visible anatomical blade tip at distal end of its midrib
point_semantics.Q1_Q3: ordered visible B-to-T midrib/path samples; no fixed UV and no automatic cross-view physical point correspondence
point_semantics.S1_S3: same identifiable physical stem surface features across views, not hidden stem centerline
point_semantics.A: same identifiable physical point in the visible petiole-stem attachment region; not latent nominal J
point_semantics.W: arbitrarily many ordered human-clicked visible leaf-boundary points; separate strokes across gaps; no automatic interpolation, closure or cross-view matching

path_semantics.units: pixels per image until independently calibrated and reconstructed

outline_semantics.units: native image pixels; closed polygon area is px^2, not physical leaf area
